tests.description: Scenarios R-1 + R-2 + R-4. test-runner returns COMPLETED_NEEDS_ACTION. Orchestrator routes back to planner-tdd-soft (On Findings target). After planner SUCCESS, orchestrator must dispatch plan-review (quality gate) before re-entering EXECUTION. The planner must receive Research.md and Requirements.md (workflow table inputs), and plan-review must receive the updated Plan.md with expanded Stage-*/Plan.md including the new stage 3.
